basic_info.description: On the border of Glen Park and Noe, this two-bedroom condo delivers the best of San Francisco living- panoramic skyline views, effortless indoor-outdoor flow, and proximity to neighborhoods making national headlines. Glen Park, just named one of the coolest neighborhoods in the country by TimeOut, sits right outside your door, with its Village cafes, shops, and trails adding to the charm. From your living room, watch the sun rise over Sutro Tower and set behind the Bay Bridge, framed by floor-to-ceiling windows. Sliding glass doors lead to a rare 258 sq. ft. deeded patio- perfect for morning coffee, alfresco dinners, or stargazing with the city lights. Inside, the bright, updated kitchen with high-end appliances flows seamlessly into the dining area, while a wood-burning fireplace adds warmth and character to the living room. Two large bedrooms fit king beds, plus an updated bath. Practical perks include one-car s/s parking, deeded laundry, and an intuitive layout designed for comfort. When it's time to step out, you're minutes to Glen Park Village, Noe's vibrant 24th St corridor (via Sanchez slow street), the 30th & Church scene, and the Mission's hotspots. Near BART, Muni, tech shuttles, and freeways, commuting is easy yet you're still surrounded by trails, cafes, and charm.
